A0163.title: Data Minimization and Purpose Limitation
A0163.definition: Collect only necessary data and restrict its usage scope to reduce the risk of data breaches
A0163.description: Data governance: minimization principle; purpose limitation; storage duration; periodic purging; anonymization; de-identification; privacy impact assessment.
A0163.limitation: Conflicts with business requirements, changes in regulatory mandates, and purging may impact functionality. After minimization, missing historical data may incorrectly block legitimate user access for compliance and audit purposes. Additionally, de-identified data can still be re-identified by attackers through correlation with multiple external datasets, posing risks of false positives and circumvention.
